title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, FlowAI, Kaaiser and Edugo.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Most recruiters spend their careers fighting the same fight: a broken ATS, manual screening that eats the whole day, a hiring manager who ghosts the scorecard, a pipeline that starts from zero every time a req opens. That fight is largely over at Manifest. Resume screening, first\-round AI phone screening, and interview scheduling already run on a live automation pipeline. Every open role carries a structured AI\-Lens score before a hire is made. The administrative weight that usually defines a recruiter's day is already handled.
   

  

 What's left is the part of the job that actually matters, and the part most recruiters never get enough time to do well: reading a role correctly before you source for it, building a pipeline before the req is desperate, coaching a hiring manager through a real interview instead of a rubber stamp, and closing a candidate who has other offers on the table. That's this role. You inherit a portfolio of open roles across the Manifest brand family, and you own each one end to end, inside a system built to let you spend your time on judgment, not logistics.
   

  

 You own proving that a recruiter given real leverage, real tools, and real ownership can outperform a much bigger team running the old way.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most Senior Talent Acquisition roles ask you to either inherit chaos or build infrastructure from nothing. This one asks something rarer: step into a function that's already operating ahead of where most companies' TA teams will be in a few years, and bring the craft that no automation stack can replace. If your best days as a recruiter are the ones spent actually talking to people, reading a candidate's real motivation, coaching a hiring manager into asking a better question, this is a role built around giving you more of those days, not fewer.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem means your work isn't confined to one brand's hiring needs in isolation. You're building pipelines across a group actively investing in never starting critical searches from a blank page again, and the muscle you build here compounds across every brand you touch, not just one.
   

  

**What You Own**
 Your portfolio of open roles, assigned as you join, owned end to end and tracked against a tiered service standard that separates urgent hires from foundational ones
   

  

 Calibration and pipeline quality on every role you run: structured scorecards, AI\-Lens scoring, and honest debate on any candidate who raises a real question, never a quiet pass or fail
   

  

 Hiring manager partnership, coaching certified managers through structured interviewing and treating your own read on a role as something worth defending, not just executing
   

  

 Pipeline building on the roles Manifest hires for again and again, so the next opening in your portfolio starts with a warm pool, not a cold search
   

  

 Candidate experience on everything you touch, every applicant treated like their eventual review of Manifest matters, because it does
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where the function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics to your actual portfolio once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first weeks, you're ramped on your assigned roles and already a real contributor to how the function reads its own performance, not still learning the tools while roles sit open.
   

  

 By mid\-period, your roles are closing at a pace that reflects real calibration, your hiring managers trust your judgment enough to move fast on your recommendation, and at least one of your searches started from a pipeline you built before the req opened, not after.
   

  

 In the long term, you're one of the people other recruiters and hiring managers point to when they want to see what good calibration actually looks like, and your portfolio is proof the system works because of the person running it, not just the automation underneath it.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've recruited at real volume before, across more than a handful of roles at once, and you know the difference between a candidate who looks good on paper and one who'll actually close. You're coachable, genuinely energized by stepping into a system someone else designed well, rather than needing to rebuild it your way before you can do good work.
   

  

 You're fluent in using AI tools in your own recruiting practice, not just aware that AI\-native recruiting exists. You've screened, scored, or sourced with AI tools directly, and you light up talking about what changed when you did.
   

  

 You're comfortable with a little ambiguity at the start. Your exact portfolio isn't fixed until you join, and you'd rather find out and move than need it decided for you months in advance.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of how this function actually runs and your first reaction was not "that sounds like a lot of process," it was "finally, a recruiting job built around the parts I'm actually good at." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 150\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $91M raised. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest is trying to prove a five\-brand, multi\-country hiring function can run better than companies many times its size. That only happens with recruiters who want to be excellent at the craft, not just keep the pipeline moving.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Great Teams Don’t Happen by Accident** 




 Behind every ambitious company is someone who can recognise exceptional talent before everyone else does—and influence that talent to make the right career move.
 



  





 At Inc42, Talent Acquisition is not a CV\-forwarding or interview\-coordination function. It is a business\-critical mandate that requires market intelligence, sound judgement, candidate influence and the ability to close high\-value talent.
 



  





 From identifying a specialist product leader or growth marketer to engaging an experienced editor, designer or technologist, you will help build the teams shaping how India’s startup economy is reported, understood and experienced.
 



  





 If you know how to find talent hidden in plain sight, establish authority with accomplished candidates, influence senior stakeholders and successfully negotiate complex offers, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Inc42 is expanding across media, intelligence, products, events, communities and learning. That growth depends on hiring people who combine functional excellence with curiosity, ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to own full\-cycle recruitment across Product, Marketing, Growth, Technology, Design, Editorial and leadership functions.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Head of People Operations, Founders and Functional Leaders to translate business requirements into compelling talent mandates, build high\-quality candidate pipelines and take candidates from the first conversation through assessment, negotiation, closure and onboarding.
 



  





 This role requires the instincts of a talent hunter, the influence of a trusted advisor and the commercial judgement of an effective closer.
 



  





**About Inc42** 




 Inc42 is India’s largest media and intelligence platform focused on the startup economy—but we are not just one kind of company.
 



 We operate at the intersection of journalism, data intelligence, technology, founder learning, iconic industry experiences and high\-trust communities. Our ecosystem includes:
 


* **Inc42’s authoritative journalism** 
 , reporting on the companies, people and forces shaping India’s technology economy
* **Datalabs** 
 , India’s largest free startup database, covering 75,000\+ companies
* **D2CX** 
 , our learning and community platform designed to help D2C founders build, scale and lead stronger businesses
* Flagship editorial IPs such as the
 **AI Summit, D2C \& Retail Summit, FAST42 and D2C Retreat**
* **Griffin** 
 , India’s most curated private founder club



 This breadth brings together an unusually diverse team of journalists, researchers, product builders, technologists, designers, marketers, creators, educators and business operators—all working towards one mission: to inform, enable and connect the people building India’s technology economy.
 



  





 For Talent Acquisition, that makes Inc42 a uniquely exciting organisation to build. Hiring here is neither repetitive nor transactional. One mandate could involve finding a deeply specialised editorial leader, the next a product or technology professional, and another a creative, growth, learning or business leader.
 



  





 As part of People Operations, you will help build the multidisciplinary teams behind Inc42’s next phase—shaping the organisation from the inside while influencing how India’s startup economy is understood on the outside.
 



  





**Your Mandate** 




 Build a high\-quality, future\-ready talent engine for Inc42 across six pillars:
 


* **Senior and leadership hiring:** 
 Independently manage complex, business\-critical mandates from discovery to closure.
* **Talent strategy:** 
 Translate business objectives and workforce requirements into focused hiring plans.
* **Talent discovery:** 
 Find high\-calibre active and passive candidates through research\-led and creative sourcing.
* **Candidate influence:** 
 Establish credibility, communicate the Inc42 opportunity and confidently guide senior candidates through important career decisions.
* **Hiring quality and speed:** 
 Close multiple roles without compromising functional excellence, values alignment or candidate quality.
* **Recruitment intelligence:** 
 Use data, talent\-market insights and hiring trends to continuously improve outcomes.



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* **Senior and leadership hiring:** 
 Independently manage business\-critical searches across Product, Technology, Marketing, Growth, Design, Editorial and other functions.
* **Full\-cycle recruitment:** 
 Own every stage—from mandate discovery, job design and market mapping to sourcing, assessment, negotiation, closure and onboarding coordination.
* **Compelling role positioning:** 
 Turn business requirements into differentiated JDs and candidate narratives that attract the right profiles—not merely more applications.
* **Talent discovery:** 
 Build strong active and passive pipelines through job platforms, professional communities, referrals, databases, direct outreach and creative sourcing.
* **Stakeholder advisory:** 
 Partner with the Head of People Operations and functional leaders on role requirements, market availability, compensation, candidate quality and hiring trade\-offs.
* **Influence with evidence:** 
 Use talent intelligence and sound judgement to challenge unrealistic expectations, accelerate decisions and improve hiring outcomes.
* **Candidate assessment:** 
 Conduct structured, competency\-based and situational interviews that evaluate functional capability, problem\-solving, ownership and values alignment.
* **Candidate influence and closure:** 
 Build credibility with senior professionals, understand their motivations and confidently manage competing offers, counteroffers, negotiations and joining risks.
* **Candidate experience:** 
 Ensure every interaction is timely, transparent and thoughtful while building relationships that extend beyond an immediate opening.
* **Recruitment intelligence:** 
 Maintain accurate ATS records, track key hiring metrics and use data to improve sourcing, assessment and closure.
* **Quality and compliance:** 
 Apply recruitment best practices and ensure screening, selection and documentation comply with applicable employment regulations.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Business\-critical, senior and leadership roles have strong and relevant candidate pipelines.
* Senior candidates are successfully converted from initial outreach to accepted offers and joining.
* Time\-to\-source and time\-to\-hire improve without lowering the quality bar.
* Complex negotiations, competing offers and counteroffer situations are handled with confidence and commercial judgement.
* Offer acceptance and joining ratios remain healthy across critical positions.
* Senior candidates view the recruiter as a credible representative of Inc42 and a trusted source of career context.
* Hiring managers rely on Talent Acquisition for market intelligence and hiring judgement—not only process execution.
* Stakeholders receive clear recommendations and hiring decisions move forward decisively.
* Candidates experience timely, transparent and engaging communication.
* Sources of hire are measured, and effort is directed towards channels producing the strongest candidates.
* Talent pipelines, recruitment systems and stakeholder confidence become stronger over time.
* Every hire demonstrates functional strength, ownership and alignment with Inc42’s ambition and values.



  





**Who You Are** 



* **A proven closer:** 
 You have successfully negotiated with and closed senior candidates, including those evaluating competing offers or counteroffers.
* **A sharp talent hunter:** 
 You can discover passive talent and distinguish an impressive profile from someone capable of delivering meaningful business outcomes.
* **A trusted advisor:** 
 You communicate with authority, challenge assumptions constructively and align candidates and senior stakeholders without compromising trust.
* **Commercial and outcome driven:** 
 You understand candidate motivations, compensation and market realities—and use data and judgement to improve hiring outcomes.
* **A long\-term builder:** 
 You thrive in fast\-moving, high\-ownership environments and bring sustained ownership, professional progression and measurable organisational impact.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Management or a related discipline, with a strong academic track record.
* 5–8 years of proven experience in Talent Acquisition, recruitment or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated ownership of mid\-to\-senior and leadership hiring mandates.
* Proven success in identifying, engaging, negotiating with and closing senior\-level candidates.
* Experience handling complex compensation discussions, competing offers, counteroffers and candidate objections.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills, including the confidence to influence senior leaders and constructively challenge hiring requirements.
* Ability to establish credibility and authority with experienced, highly selective candidates.
* Experience conducting structured, competency\-based and situational interviews.
* Proficiency in Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Advanced working knowledge of MS Office, database management and internet research.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, decision\-making and organisational skills.
* Working understanding of applicable employment laws and hiring regulations.
* Deep understanding of the startup ecosystem and digital media industry.
* Experience hiring across Product, Marketing, Growth, Technology, Design, Editorial or other specialist functions.
* Prior experience managing niche media hiring would be highly valued.
* Experience in digital media, startups, technology or another fast\-growth environment would be advantageous.
* A stable professional track record is strongly preferred, demonstrating sustained ownership, professional progression and measurable impact within organisations.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
   

  

 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
   

  

 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
   

  

 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
   

  

 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
   

  

**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**
 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**
* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations And The Employee Experience**
* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**
* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**
* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**
* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**
* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.
   

  

 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.
   

  

 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
   

  

 You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
   

  

 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
   

  

 You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. title: Senior Talent Operations Specialist
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, FlowAI, Kaaiser and Edugo.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Talent Operations touches the entire distance between the day someone accepts an offer and the day they eventually leave, onboarding, payroll, policy, workplace, travel, global mobility, the data and systems that hold all of it together. Most companies split this work across several dedicated teams. Manifest asks a small, sharp team to hold all of it at a standard that doesn't slip, and increasingly, to run it on AI and automation as the default way of working, not a talking point bolted onto an old process.
   

  

 This matters beyond keeping the trains running. Talent Operations is the function every employee touches constantly and every executive assumes just works, until it doesn't. And for a company that grows partly through acquisition, this function is where a good deal quietly becomes a bad one or a genuinely smooth integration, because onboarding, payroll, and systems migration are where new employees actually experience whether the acquisition was handled with care.
   

  

 This role owns a real slice of that map, allocated as you join, and is built for someone who can move fluidly across it rather than specializing narrowly in one lane. You bring data and AI\-native tools to bear on operational work that most companies still run manually, which is exactly what lets a team this size hold a scope this wide.
   

  

 You own making the operational backbone of the employee experience run the way Manifest's own product does: systemized, data\-informed, and genuinely good.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most Talent Operations roles let you go deep in one lane and stay there, payroll people stay in payroll, onboarding people stay in onboarding. This one deliberately doesn't. You're a true generalist across the full employee lifecycle, which means a faster learning curve, far more exposure than a specialist track ever offers, and real involvement in acquisition integration work most people in this function don't get near until much later in their careers.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem means your generalist range gets used across five brands and multiple geographies, not one company's steady\-state operations. Every acquisition, every new market, every policy that has to work across jurisdictions is a chance to actually use the breadth you bring, not a complication to work around.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Employee Lifecycle Operations**
* Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, making both feel deliberate rather than administrative
* Own employee contract management with the accuracy and care that a growing, multi\-country team requires
* Build the muscle memory that makes lifecycle transitions consistent regardless of which brand or market someone sits in


**Policies, Compliance, and Rewards**
* Own policy design and compliance across every jurisdiction Manifest operates in, treating this as a genuine standard, not a formality
* Partner on compensation, benefits, and payroll accuracy, understanding that this is the part of the employee experience with zero tolerance for error
* Own rewards and recognition programs that actually reflect the culture Manifest wants, not a generic points system


**Workplace, Travel, and Employee Support**
* Own the systems behind business travel, global mobility, and the talent helpdesk that employees rely on when something isn't working
* Be the person who makes navigating Manifest's operational systems feel simple, even when the underlying complexity, multiple brands, multiple countries, isn't
* Partner closely with the workplace function so the physical and operational experience of working at Manifest feels like one coherent thing, not several disconnected systems


**Data, Systems, and AI\-Native Operations**
* Own the platforms, data, and automations that run Talent Operations, treating this as core infrastructure, not an afterthought
* Bring genuine AI fluency to how operational work gets done, identifying where automation should replace manual process rather than just supplement it
* Own talent analytics and insights that give the Talent team, and the business, an honest, current read on the state of the employee experience


**Project and Vendor Management**
* Own cross\-functional Talent Operations projects end to end, including the operational side of acquisition integrations as Manifest grows
* Manage vendor relationships with real discipline, holding external partners to the same standard Manifest holds itself
* Run projects the way a strong operator does: scoped clearly, tracked honestly, delivered on the timeline you committed to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent Operations is today. We'll calibrate the specifics to your actual ownership areas once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first weeks, you've learned the real shape of Talent Operations at Manifest, met the people and systems behind each area you own, and formed a genuine point of view on what's working well and what needs a better process behind it.
   

  

 By mid\-period, the areas you own run visibly smoother, employees experience less friction navigating them, and you've brought real automation or data thinking to at least one process that used to run entirely by hand.
   

  

 In the long term, you're the person other members of the Talent team turn to when something spans more than one area of Talent Operations, because you're one of the few people who can see the whole map, not just a single lane of it.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've worked across multiple areas of Talent or HR Operations before, not just one specialty, and you're genuinely energized by breadth rather than wishing you could narrow your focus. You think in systems and processes, and you have real project management instincts, you scope things properly, track them honestly, and finish what you start.
   

  

 You're authentically data\-driven, comfortable pulling and interpreting your own numbers rather than waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard, and you use that data to actually change how something runs, not just to report on it. You're genuinely AI\-native in your own practice, you've used AI tools to automate or improve operational work yourself, and you instinctively look for where a manual process should become an automated one.
   

  

 You're comfortable with a role whose exact ownership isn't fully fixed until you join, and you'd rather find out what needs you most and move than have it all mapped out in advance.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of how wide this role's scope is and your first reaction was not "that's a lot to hold," it was "that's exactly the kind of range I want in a role." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 150\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $91M raised. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest grows in part by acquiring other companies, and every acquisition is a test of whether Talent Operations can absorb new people, new systems, and new complexity without the employee experience taking the hit. This role is one of the people who makes sure it doesn't.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

description:
**Job Description for TA Lead – International Hiring**














**Company Description (
 
 www.innefu.com
 
 )**









 Founded in 2010, Innefu is an AI Driven R\&D company providing cutting edge Data Analytics and Information Security solutions. The company was started with a clear focus to carry out high Tech R\&D which fuels innovation and leads to products which can capture the global market and be the cornerstone of the economy of the country.
 



 With more than 100\+ installations across Indian Subcontinent, Middle East and Southeast Asia, the company is today a de\-facto leader in developing and deploying AI for National and cyber\-Security.
 



  





 The company with its own range of products serves a diverse client base including Defense and Intelligence organizations, Law Enforcement Agencies, Financial Intelligence Units, BFSI as well as top Fortune 500 companies.
 



 Having worked with some of the most sensitive organizations, the company has a deep understanding of handling sensitive and critical installations. The company has a clear focus on developing state\-of\-the\-art products oriented towards solving real world problems of our clients with exemplary support to ensure 100% customer satisfaction.
 








**Job Description:**




 The Tech TA Lead will own the complete recruitment lifecycle for niche, international technical hiring — with a sharp focus on Robotics and adjacent deep\-tech talent across global markets (US, UK, Germany, Japan, Korea, and other key geographies). This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands the global robotics talent landscape and can personally source, engage, and close highly specialized engineering and research talent, while also building scalable sourcing strategy and market intelligence for the function
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the complete hiring lifecycle for international technical roles — requisition intake, global sourcing strategy, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closure — with a primary focus on Robotics.
* Personally source and close critical, niche robotics and deep\-tech positions, including:
* VLA (Vision\-Language\-Action) Research Scientist
* Multimodal AI Engineer
* Robotics Control Engineer
* Embedded Engineer / Embedded Architect
* Firmware Engineer
* Mechatronics Engineer
* and other emerging robotics/AI\-adjacent specializations as they arise.
* Product Manager
* Engineering Manager
* Solution Architect
* Build and manage sourcing strategies tailored to each target geography (US, UK, Germany, Japan, Korea, etc.), accounting for local talent pools, compensation norms, visa/work\-authorization pathways, and market\-specific sourcing channels.
* Partner with hiring managers and technical leadership to translate complex, highly specialized role requirements into clear scorecards and search strategies.
* Build and maintain a strong global pipeline/network of passive robotics and deep\-tech talent, including through direct headhunting, niche technical communities, conferences, and executive search partners where needed.
* Conduct market mapping and competitor intelligence (compensation benchmarks, talent availability, competitor hiring patterns) across each target country for robotics\-specific roles.
* Track and report hiring funnel metrics (TAT, source mix, offer\-to\-join ratio, cost per hire, drop\-off rate) specific to international/robotics requisitions.
* Manage cross\-border offer structuring and negotiation, working closely with HR/legal/compliance teams on region\-specific employment norms, relocation, and visa sponsorship where applicable.
* Standardize technical evaluation frameworks and interview scorecards for robotics and AI\-adjacent roles across all target countries.
* Manage confidential and business\-critical international hiring mandates directly with founders/CXO stakeholders.
* Own candidate experience end\-to\-end for international hires — from engagement through offer, documentation, and a smooth cross\-border onboarding handoff.



**Must\-Have Requirements** 



* Must have 5\-10 years of experience in International technical hiring
* Proven, hands\-on experience closing international technical roles, with demonstrated success hiring for Robotics positions specifically across markets such as the US, UK, Germany, Japan, and Korea.
* Track record of closing niche and critical robotics/deep\-tech mandates such as VLA Research Scientist, Multimodal AI Engineer, Robotics Control Engineer, Embedded Engineer/Architect, Firmware Engineer, and Mechatronics Engineer.
* Strong technical fluency in robotics, embedded systems, and AI/ML domains — able to independently evaluate technical talent and hold credible conversations with candidates and hiring managers.
* Experience navigating cross\-border hiring complexities — visa sponsorship, relocation, regional compensation structures, and local labor market nuances.
* Strong global sourcing skills — LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, niche technical communities/forums, and direct headhunting for passive robotics talent.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and offer\-closing skills at senior/specialist technical levels.

description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad application process by connecting international students, international student advisors, and educational institutions on one personalized platform. For more than a decade, ApplyBoard's team members have been dedicated to breaking down barriers to international education, while thriving at a company that invests in their career growth. Our six core values guide us in our mission to educate the world, and are the foundation of our company culture. As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Opportunity:**
 This role is responsible for the day\-to\-day support of our institution partners, driving targeted enrollment growth and enhancing partner satisfaction. You will execute recruitment strategies, assist in conversion initiatives, and act as a liaison between institutions and ApplyBoard’s internal teams.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing every day:**
* Execute Recruitment Strategies: Assist in implementing and optimizing recruitment strategies to help meet enrollment goals for our differentiated partners.
* Support Conversion Rates: Help enhance conversion rates by assisting in the activation and training of Recruitment Partners (RPs) and ensuring alignment with institutional priorities.
* Service Adoption: Promote the adoption of premium services and tools to enhance partner satisfaction and results.
* Engagement Customization: Support the development and customization of engagement models and reporting that align with the unique goals of each institutional partner.
* Liaison Responsibilities: Serve as a point of contact for institutional stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and collaboration with ApplyBoard teams.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams to address partner\-specific needs, troubleshoot issues, and facilitate solutions for any operational challenges.
* CRM Management: Keep detailed records in our CRM system, documenting partner activities and performance data consistently.
* Relationship Building: Conduct regular check\-ins and syncs with the institution's international recruitment and admissions teams to strengthen relationships and align strategies.
* Workshops and Training Support: Assist in organizing and facilitating monthly conversion workshops and training sessions for top recruitment partners.


**What you bring to the table:**
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in account management, sales, or recruitment, preferably in the education sector.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Strong understanding of enrollment processes and strategies within differentiated institutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.


**About ApplyBoard**
 ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. Our global team leverages cutting\-edge technology to build innovative tools and share sector insights that support our network of international students and 1,500\+ partner institutions. We've helped more than 1,300,000 students from over 180 countries with their study abroad journey so far, and we're just getting started.
   

  

 Ready to join us? We're grateful for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard team. However, only select applicants will be contacted for an interview.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence tools to support the hiring process, potentially while reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing applicant responses. These tools don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by our team members. If you'd like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 ApplyBoard welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

description:
**The opportunity** 




 This role isn't one where strategy ends with a presentation. You will research audiences and culture, shape brand ideas, and bring them to life. One day, you might unpack why a cultural moment is relevant to a brand; another day, you might edit a reel, adapt packaging, build a launch post, or plan the next week’s social calendar. The aim is to learn by building, publishing and improving real work.
 



  





**About Brand Aid Kit** 




 Brand Aid Kit is a marketing consultancy that helps emerging consumer businesses build brands. We combine consumer insight, brand strategy, storytelling and hands\-on execution to turn early\-stage ideas into distinctive brands and market\-ready campaigns. This means close exposure to the complete brand\-building process: from understanding consumers and defining the strategy to making creative choices, launching campaigns and learning from their performance.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 • Track pop culture, internet behaviour, fashion, entertainment, food, design and creator trends relevant to each brand
 



 • Turn consumer and cultural observations into content ideas, campaign territories and clear creative briefs

 • Create, edit and publish short\-form video including reels, product edits, founder\-led content and trend\-responsive formats
 



 • Design and adapt static assets including social posts, carousels, stories, packaging, menus, marketplace graphics, presentation assets and basic web creatives
 



 • Write or refine hooks, captions, scripts, headlines, calls to action and brand copy
 



 • Support shoots through concepts, moodboards, shot lists, styling references and on\-ground coordination where agreed

 • Present progress and recommendations during the weekly strategy review and take ownership of agreed deadlines
 



  





**Skills and tools** 




 • Strong awareness of Indian and global pop culture, social media behaviour and emerging internet formats
 



 • Working proficiency in short\-form video editing using Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or an equivalent tool
 



 • Working proficiency in static design and image editing using Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma, Canva or equivalent tools
 



 • Understanding of AI tools \& willingness to learn AI\-based asset creation
 



 • Ability to work with packaging artwork and brand assets with care for dimensions, hierarchy, consistency and production handoff
 



 • Strong visual judgment across typography, colour, composition, imagery and platform conventions
 



 • Clear writing and an instinct for hooks, captions, scripts and contemporary brand voice
 



 • Basic understanding of social analytics and the ability to turn performance into a practical recommendation
 



 • Reliable project management, file organization, communication and openness to feedback
 



  





**Who should apply** 




 • NIFT student with an interest in brand strategy \& brand management

 • Someone comfortable switching between distinct brand worlds without making them look or sound the same
 



 • Someone who can work independently from a clear brief and ask focused questions when direction is missing
 



 • Someone excited by blank pages, early\-stage ambiguity and the chance to help define what a brand becomes
 



  





**Location \& working rhythm** 




 • Location: Lucknow/Delhi
 



 • Workdays: 6 days
 



 • Hybrid work model
 



  





**How to apply:** 




 1\. Fill out this form: https://brandaidkit.in/nift\-gp\-hiring 
 



 2\. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 24 hrs to complete a brief assignment. The assignment will test cultural judgment, strategic thinking, video editing and static adaptation.
 



 3\. Candidates with selected assignments will have a 1:1 interview
 



 4\. We welcome you to your Graduation Project with us!

description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**About Allica Bank**
 Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company \- and the fastest\-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
   

  

 Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities \- representing over a third of our economy \- yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
   

  

**Department Description**
 The Human Resource team is a small but growing team who are supporting Allica Bank and its employees to reach their goals. We’re a hands\-on team and there is great opportunity to develop your career whilst you help build one of the UK’s newest banks. Our employees are what helps us different from our competitors as part of the Human Resources team you will work on projects including engagement, recruitment, reward, L\&D and our ways of working with the aim of ensuring our employees are as effective as possible and Allica is truly great place to work.
   

  

**Role Description**
 The role of Senior Recruiter at Allica Bank will be responsible for leading recruitment campaigns across the business. The role will play a key part in ensuring that Allica Bank has the resources it requires to meet its growth agenda and ensuring that all candidates who are interacting with Allica Bank have a best\-in\-class candidate experience. The person will work with the Recruitment team, India head and Stakeholders to implement Allica’s recruitment strategy utilising methods to attract candidates, screen applicants, headhunt, arrange interviews and support candidates through to being onboarded as colleagues.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities** 
 
   

  

* Hire great people at pace 
* Build great relationships across the bank and support with the relevant business areas to assess their recruitment needs and manage campaigns to meet these needs
* Manage Allica Bank’s recruitment channels through agencies, direct and social media
* Manage Allica Banks End to End recruitment process  I
* nterview and screen prospective candidates to provide the business with high quality and diverse candidates 
* Role model and promote Allica culture and values 
* Develop and produce recruitment MI to support the refinement of Allica’s process and to drive improved outcomes for candidates and Allica


**Personal Attributes \& Experience** 
 
   

  

* Overall experience of 8\-10 years with Previous Banking/FS recruitment experience in managing the full recruitment cycle and the delivery of recruitment services, ideally from an in\-house environment or an RPO or recruitment agency 
* Proven experience of implementing recruitment strategies across organisations
* Experience in working with 3rd party suppliers such as media and agencies and Linkedin 
* Experience using Direct sourcing tools (such as LinkedIn, talent pooling, Executive Search and working with relevant job boards) 
* Commercial understanding of the business and how recruitment can support the requirements of stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills, to manage multiple recruitment campaigns, demands and tight deadlines 
* Ability to plan ahead to provide proactive Recruitment support to the business  Pragmatic, diplomatic, and a good team player
* Strong interpersonal skills, working effectively at all levels of the organisation


**Working at Allica Bank**
 At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
   

  

 Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
   

  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity \& Paternity leave


**Don’t tick every box?**
 Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
   

  

**Flexible working**
 We know the ‘9\-to\-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
   

  

**Diversity**
 We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

 You will own hiring end to end at Stantech AI.  Your Desk is a fast\-growing real estate enterprise operating across multiple verticals — sub\-leased
 



 office spaces, managed office spaces, real estate consultancy, corporate interior designing, and
 



 co\-working spaces. With the aim of creating workspace solutions for companies of all sizes, Your
 



 Desk currently has 3 active co\-working spaces already running in Gurugram and several more in
 



 the pipeline.
 



 Our co\-working spaces are built for the modern professional — featuring state\-of\-the\-art
 



 workstations, premium amenities, and flexible workspace solutions that cater to freelancers,
 



 startups, SMEs, and large enterprises alike. Your Desk strives to provide customised and curated
 



 solutions for various office needs through its solutions.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic, fast\-growing organisation that values talent and fosters
 



 growth, join us and build your future with Your Desk.
 



  





**About the Role — “Human Resouces Executive”** 




 The HR team is dedicated to building the people function of Your Desk — from hiring the right talent to supporting them through their journey with us. This role plays a central part in every centre's operations by keeping our people processes running smoothly and compliantly. We are looking for a dynamic, detail\-oriented HR Executive to own end\-to\-end HR operations for Your Desk LLP, working closely with the founder, centre managers, and community managers across all locations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Recruitment \& Onboarding** 




 • Manage the full recruitment cycle — sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and offer rollout — for roles across all Your Desk centres.
 



 • Prepare and issue offer letters and appointment letters in line with company templates and standard terms.
 



 • Coordinate onboarding and induction for new joiners, including documentation, orientation, and centre placement.
 



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 




 • Maintain accurate employee records, HR databases, and personnel files (physical and digital).
 



 • Track attendance, leaves, and probation timelines across all centres; flag confirmations and renewals on time.
 



 • Administer and help implement HR policies — leave policy, code of conduct, and other company guidelines.
 



 • Ensure statutory and labour law compliance (PF, ESI, POSH, and other applicable regulations).
 



 • Maintain HR MIS and prepare periodic reports for leadership.
 



**Employee Relations \& Engagement** 




 • Act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, escalating as needed.
 



 • Support performance review cycles and coordinate feedback documentation with centre managers. • Assist with employee engagement initiatives and culture\-building activities across centres.
 



 • Manage full and final settlements, exit interviews, and offboarding formalities.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (mandatory).
 



 • MBA or Post\-Graduate Diploma in HR is an added advantage.
 



 • Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience in an HR generalist role.
 



 • Prior experience in real estate, coworking, hospitality, or a multi\-location service business is preferred.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




 We are looking for driven professionals who combine strong process discipline with genuine care for people. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
 



 • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 • Working knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort with HR/attendance tools.
 



 • Integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self\-awareness, work ethic, and empathy.
 



 • Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
 



 • Strong multitasking abilities to manage HR operations across multiple centre locations.
 



 • A problem\-solving mindset with a high sense of ownership.
 



  





**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, Permanent
 



**Work Location:** 
 In person — Gurugram, Haryana (reliably commute or plan to relocate before
 



 starting work — preferred).

**Company Description** 
 ALM International, headquartered in New Delhi, is a global leader in human resources for medical and paramedical professionals, operating since 1984\. The organization has a strong track record of matching qualified individuals with reputable employers worldwide. With a vast network, extensive database, and structured processes, the company consistently delivers high\-caliber talent to demanding clients. ALM International is ranked \#1 in the fields of Healthcare and Education and applies a value\-based approach across other major industries.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Recruiter role based in New Delhi. The Recruiter will manage end\-to\-end hiring processes for Mostly medical, paramedical, and other professional roles, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, and conducting initial interviews. The role involves coordinating with client organizations to understand job requirements, aligning candidate profiles with those needs, and scheduling and facilitating interviews. The Recruiter will maintain and update candidate databases, track recruitment metrics, and ensure timely communication with both clients and candidates. Additional responsibilities include supporting recruitment campaigns, attending job fairs or information sessions as needed, and contributing to process improvements to enhance hiring efficiency and candidate experience.

* Strong skills in candidate sourcing, resume screening, and conducting structured interviews.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and candidates, with excellent stakeholder management.
* Proficiency in using recruitment platforms, applicant tracking systems, and basic office software.
* Solid communication and negotiation skills, including clear written and verbal correspondence.
* Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple requisitions and deadlines.
* Understanding of healthcare and education sectors, or willingness to develop domain knowledge.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field preferred.
* Prior experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, especially for international placements, is an advantage.

title: Talent Acquisition Associate
description:
**About MyHQ**
 myHQ is India's largest commercial real estate and flex workspace marketplace. Founded in 2016 by IIT Delhi graduates, we give 50,000\+ enterprises\- from early\-stage startups to large MNCs and GCCs, access to 10,000\+ workspace options across 10\+ cities, covering coworking, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and managed offices.
   

  

 In five years, we've grown 30x and closed two back\-to\-back profitable years. Backed by ANAROCK Group and WeWork India, we're building toward ₹1,000Cr, and hiring the team that gets us there.
   

  

 We believe where you work shapes what you build. Our mission is to make the right workspace accessible to every business in India, and increasingly, beyond it. With expansion already underway in Dubai and London, we're building something with a genuinely large surface area.
   

  

 For the people who join us, that translates to real opportunity. We've paid out over ₹10Cr in performance bonuses in the last couple of years, and we've watched team members buy homes, build wealth, and grow into roles that didn't exist when they joined. The next five years will be harder than the last five, and significantly more rewarding.
   

  

**Our Culture**
**We Look For People With The Following Characteristics**
* Humble and hardworking: Two traits we hire for and live by; the best people here are the ones who show up fully and let the work speak
* High ownership: You'll own real work from day one, not just assist on it; the buck stops with you, and leadership backs you up
* Bias for action: We move fast, learn faster, and don't overthink; experimentation is encouraged, paralysis is not
* Open and direct: Smart people, honest conversations, no politics; feedback flows both ways and that's how we get better


**Our Products**
* Day Passes: On demand access to coworking spaces across India, booked by the day
* Meeting Rooms: Hourly bookings across 2,000\+ venues in 10\+ cities
* Virtual Offices: Registered business address with GST support and mail handling
* Managed Offices: Fully fitted, ready\-to\-move offices with no long\-term lock\-in
* Enterprise Leasing: End\-to\-end commercial leasing for large teams, handled by our Assisted Marketplace team
* MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibition): Venue sourcing and management for corporate events, trainings, off\-sites, and conferences


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-ownership Talent Acquisition Associate who will be the engine behind myHQ's hiring sourcing, screening, and moving candidates through the pipeline across our sales, operations, and marketplace verticals.
   

  

 This role requires someone who knows how to source fast, understands high\-volume sales hiring, can move fast and build strong pipelines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Source candidates across LinkedIn, Naukri, and referrals for sales, operations, and support roles
* Manage high\-volume hiring pipelines across sales teams
* Run first\-round screening calls and assess fit before scheduling the interviews with the business team
* Own interview scheduling and coordination across busy internal calendars
* Maintain pipeline hygiene, accurate records on our ATS with right stages and information
* Track offer\-to\-joining conversion and flag risks before they become vacancies
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for inside sales and business development roles
* Support sourcing strategy inputs for campus and lateral hiring
* Proactively create talent pools for recurring roles


**Requirements**
* 1–4 years of Talent Acquisition experience, ideally at a fast\-moving startup or services company
* Strong sourcer: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referral activation
* Clear communicator: candidates should feel informed, not chased
* Genuinely organized to handle high volume bulk hiring
* Ability to work on an ATS is a plus
* Experience in sales hiring / inside sales hiring is mandatory
